args.old_string:
- Remove the first entry. This will always be either "" or the working directory
    - Remove the working directory from the second and third entries
      if PYTHONPATH includes a ":" at the beginning or the end.
      https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/issues/3636
      Don't remove it if PYTHONPATH contains the cwd or '.' as the entry will
      only be added once.
    - Don't remove the working directory from the rest. It will be included
      if pylint is installed in an editable configuration (as the last item).
      https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/issues/4161
    """
    sys.path.pop(0)

    - Remove the working directory from the second and third entries
      if PYTHONPATH includes a ":" at the beginning or the end.
      https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/issues/3636
      Don't remove it if PYTHONPATH contains the cwd or '.' as the entry will

    - Don't remove the working directory from the rest. It will be included
      if pylint is installed in an editable configuration (as the last item).
      https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/issues/4161
    """
    cwd = os.getcwd()
    if sys.path[0] in {"", ".", cwd}:
        sys.path.pop(0)

import sys, os
from unittest.mock import patch
from copy import copy
from pylint import modify_sys_path

cwd = "C:/Windows/Temp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_do_not_import_files_from_0"
default_paths = ["/usr/local/lib/python39.zip", "/usr/local/lib/python3.9",
                 "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/lib-dynload", "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages"]

def run(paths, pythonpath):
    with patch("os.getcwd", return_value=cwd), patch.dict(os.environ, {"PYTHONPATH": pythonpath} if pythonpath else {}, clear=False):
        sys.path = copy(paths)
        modify_sys_path()
        return sys.path

cases = [
    ([cwd, *default_paths], "", [cwd, *default_paths][1:]),
    ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], ".", [cwd, cwd, *default_paths][1:]),
    ([cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", *default_paths], "/custom_pythonpath", [cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", *default_paths][1:]),
    ([cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", cwd, *default_paths], "/custom_pythonpath:", [[cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", cwd, *default_paths][1]] + [cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", cwd, *default_paths][3:]),
    (["", cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", *default_paths], ":/custom_pythonpath", ["", cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", *default_paths][2:]),
    ([cwd, cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", *default_paths], ":/custom_pythonpath:", [cwd, cwd, "/custom_pythonpath", *default_paths][2:]),
    ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], ":.", [cwd, cwd, *default_paths][1:]),
    ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], f":{cwd}", [cwd, cwd, *default_paths][1:]),
    ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], ".:", [cwd, cwd, *default_paths][1:]),
    ([cwd, cwd, *default_paths], f"{cwd}:", [cwd, cwd, *default_paths][1:]),
    (["", cwd, *default_paths, cwd], cwd, ["", cwd, *default_paths, cwd][1:]),
]
for i, (paths, pp, expected) in enumerate(cases):
    got = run(paths, pp)
    assert got == expected, f"case {i} FAILED: {got} != {expected}"
print(f"all {len(cases)} test_modify_sys_path contract cases PASS")

# new behavior: non-cwd first entry preserved
got = run(["something", *default_paths], "")
assert got == ["something", *default_paths], got
print("non-cwd first entry preserved: PASS")
EOF
